python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# CPI-U annual averages
cpi_1992 = 140.30833333333334
cpi_1993 = 144.475
cpi_1994 = 148.225

# Interest-bearing debt for series E and EE (calendar years, in millions)
debt_1992 = 144724
debt_1993 = 158633
debt_1994 = 166731

# Adjust to constant 1994 dollars
# Formula: adjusted = nominal * (CPI_1994 / CPI_year)
adjusted_1992 = debt_1992 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1992)
adjusted_1993 = debt_1993 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1993)
adjusted_1994 = debt_1994 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1994)  # This is just debt_1994

print("Inflation-adjusted values in constant 1994 dollars (millions):")
print(f"1992: {adjusted_1992:.2f}")
print(f"1993: {adjusted_1993:.2f}")
print(f"1994: {adjusted_1994:.2f}")

# Calculate sample mean
values = [adjusted_1992, adjusted_1993, adjusted_1994]
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean:.2f}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation (n-1 denominator)
# This is the "sample z-score" - uses sample std dev with n-1
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / (n - 1)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Sample standard deviation (n-1): {std_dev:.2f}")

# Calculate z-score for 1994
z_score = (adjusted_1994 - mean) / std_dev
print(f"\nZ-score for 1994: {z_score:.2f}")

# Also show intermediate calculations
print("\n--- Detailed calculation ---")
print(f"CPI adjustment factor for 1992: {cpi_1994 / cpi_1992:.6f}")
print(f"CPI adjustment factor for 1993: {cpi_1994 / cpi_1993:.6f}")
print(f"CPI adjustment factor for 1994: {cpi_1994 / cpi_1994:.6f}")
EOF
